statement: No GET_REPORT 0xA3 request is found in the pinned SDL 3.2.0 PS4 HIDAPI implementation; an 0xA3 firmware stub may be necessary for historical hid-sony and useful for version metadata in newer kernel, but there is no evidence SDL itself requires it for PS4 HIDAPI acceptance.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps4.c 76–80, 207–351, 462–647; Linux contrasts. No evidence is scoped to this pinned SDL consumer, not universal.
